benefits.text: hince lip oil coats the lips with a soft layer of color, helping keep lips soft and smooth throughout the day. With high moisturizing ability, the product effectively helps restore moisture to dry, chapped lips – especially ideal in dry weather or when lips are dehydrated from frequent matte lipstick use.

howToUse.text:
DAYTIME: Use the product regularly throughout the day to keep lips moist and smooth
NIGHTTIME: Apply a thick layer before bed for a deep moisturizing effect similar to a sleeping mask.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.

positioning.text: Lip oil in natural nude orange, coating the lips with a light gloss that helps lips feel softer and smoother and look plumper.

sellingPoints.text: Soft, easy-to-wear layer of color; highly moisturizing for dry lips; can be used day and night as a thick moisturizing layer.

finish.text: Juicy gloss / moist and smooth / light nude orange.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it restores lips in a medical sense. Darkening of the product tip over time is a natural process due to the natural pigments in the ingredient list, according to the documentation.

shadeDescription.text: Natural nude orange, fresh citrus scent

positioning.text: Strawberry pink-red lip oil, giving a light layer of color and a juicy gloss that helps lips look fresher, softer and more lively.

sellingPoints.text: Soft strawberry pink-red color; highly moisturizing; can be applied as a thick layer at night like a lip sleeping mask.

finish.text: Juicy gloss / strawberry pink-red / juicy lips.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it treats dry/chapped lips. Discoloration/staining of the product tip may occur due to temperature, light or natural pigments, according to the documentation.
